### Bitcoin touch-contract backtest, out-of-sample, 2019-2025 (Ethereum from 2020, Solana from 2024).
Pick an **asset** above. Log loss and Brier: lower is better. `naive_2x` is the rule-of-thumb baseline (twice the finish-beyond probability); `har_mix` is the model this project ships. Full derivation and discussion: [notebooks/08_backtest_and_calibration.ipynb](../../notebooks/08_backtest_and_calibration.ipynb).

panels.title: Log loss by model (lower is better)

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, log_loss FROM core.backtest_score WHERE asset = '$asset' AND year = 0 ORDER BY log_loss

panels.title: Brier skill vs the naive rule (higher is better; 0 = tied)

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, brier_skill_vs_naive FROM core.backtest_score WHERE asset = '$asset' AND year = 0 AND model != 'naive_2x' ORDER BY brier_skill_vs_naive DESC

panels.title: Is har_mix really better than the naive rule? (95% interval, week-clustered bootstrap)

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, round(log_loss_diff::numeric,4) AS log_loss_diff, round(ci_low::numeric,4) AS ci_95_low, round(ci_high::numeric,4) AS ci_95_high, CASE WHEN ci_high < 0 THEN 'better' WHEN ci_low > 0 THEN 'worse' ELSE 'no evidence either way' END AS verdict FROM core.backtest_diff WHERE asset = '$asset' AND vs = 'naive_2x' ORDER BY log_loss_diff

panels.title: Calibration slope by model (1.0 = perfectly calibrated)

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, calibration_slope FROM core.backtest_score WHERE asset = '$asset' AND year = 0 ORDER BY calibration_slope DESC

panels.title: Year by year: naive rule vs the shipped model (log loss)

targets.rawSql: SELECT make_date(year,1,1) AS time, model, log_loss FROM core.backtest_score WHERE asset = '$asset' AND year > 0 AND model IN ('naive_2x','har_mix') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Every model, every asset, all years combined

targets.rawSql: SELECT asset, model, n, round(log_loss::numeric,4) AS log_loss, round(brier::numeric,4) AS brier, round(brier_skill_vs_naive::numeric,4) AS brier_skill_vs_naive, round(calibration_slope::numeric,3) AS calibration_slope FROM core.backtest_score WHERE year = 0 ORDER BY asset, log_loss
